# Public Domain Pack (OpenGameArt)

**Source:** https://opengameart.org/content/public-domain-pack  
**Author:** drummyfish  
**License:** CC0  
**Download:** `public domain game pack.zip` (installed 2026-07-19)

## Contents (~95 files, ~26 MB)

Vintage / cut-out public domain art processed for games:

- **Architecture:** cathedral, church, temple, columns, house, round_house  
- **Nature:** trees, rocks, flowers  
- **Animals:** many fish, birds, crow, elephant, dragonfly, pufflefish…  
- **Decor / GUI-friendly:** decorations, masks, skulls, armor bits  
- **Portraits:** portrait1–8 (character faces)  
- **Backgrounds:** `background_forest.png`, `background_house.png`  
- **Misc:** cursor, fonts, pixel stitching art  
- **`sources.txt`** — origin of each public-domain work  

## WRLDZ use

| Asset | Use |
|-------|-----|
| `background_forest.png` / house | Soft overworld / hub wash (secondary to YgoRefs maps) |
| `cathedral*.png`, `temple.png`, columns | Battle City architecture decals on map |
| `portrait*.png` | Generic NPC / shopkeeper faces |
| `skull*.png`, decorations | Dark / Umbrax tear pin flourishes |
| `cursor.png` | Desktop cursor optional |

Prefer **YgoRefs** for official YGO UI; this pack fills **generic scenic / prop** gaps without inventing art.
